description: §15.10.1 (S459 H1) — ONE component scope: `let n` declared at component-body top level shadows the `bind n` prop in every LATER `${}` block of the body, not only in its own statement list. The later functions write the LOCAL `n`; the parent cell `@v` stays 7. Before S459 the later block resolved `n` to the prop and wrote the parent's cell (`_scrml_cs_reactive_set("v", 5)`), silently.
rationale: §15.10.1: "From the point of declaration onward in the same scope, the local binding shadows the prop." §15.11.1: "A local declaration, parameter or loop binder named like the prop is not the prop (§15.10.1 Shadowing) and is writable." §15.10.1's Greeter example: markup after a component logic block is the same scope.
